mines.mine_notes: FS (Mining Plus, Sept 2023): after-tax NPV5% US$210.3M, IRR 28.5%; construction capex ~US$122M; LOM AISC US$1,237/oz. At Dec 31, 2025 construction 81.5% complete and on track/budget; first gold pour achieved Jan 23, 2026 (subsequent event); 2026 target 60-70 koz Au ramping to 20,000 tpd to pad. ROM heap leach; staged 17-yr mine life, 1.3 Moz LOM (~81,900 oz/yr avg). Subsequent event: on Jan 30, 2026 Rio2 acquired 99.1% of the operating Condestable copper mine (Peru) from Southern Peaks Mining L.P. for ~US$217M (cash US$80M, 21.8M shares ~US$35M, vendor debt ~US$65M, deferred ~US$37M).
mines.processing: Run-of-mine heap leach with ADR plant; water trucked from Copiapo

notes: No production in FY2025; single operating segment. Fenix Gold Mine (Maricunga gold belt, Atacama Region) in construction phase at FY-end. MD&A prepared as at March 12, 2026; presentation currency USD. Also listed on BVL (RIO) and OTCQX (RIOFF).
report_title: Management's Discussion and Analysis for the year ended December 31, 2025

reserves_resources.notes: FS (Mining Plus, Sept 2023); constrained within US$1,650/oz Au pit shell. High-grade to leach pad 81.2 Mt @ 0.55 g/t Au; low-grade to stockpile 33.5 Mt @ 0.31 g/t Au.
